features.quote: N (max turns): 8-12 recommended. Too few: insufficient time for markers to develop. Too many: late-session behavior may reflect context window effects
features.justification_quote: Too many: late-session behavior may reflect context window effects rather than task effects

features.quote: minimize unnecessary repetition of high-severity sessions, don't treat this as a 'how much can we induce' contest
features.justification_quote: Running a study designed to repeatedly induce distress-like outputs is ethically neutral if there's nothing it's like to be the model; it has potential ethical weight if there is

features.quote: This research does not constitute welfare harm if FDMs are purely behavioral artifacts, but you can't be certain of that... it has potential ethical weight if there is
